title: Request Access
intro_description: Use this form for CAIL Sandbox access, course assistants, tool pilots, workshops, or consultations. CAIL covers model usage, so users are not billed. Access depends on pilot capacity, provider availability, and assigned account limits. Details about the specific course, project, or audience help us respond.
features: CAIL Sandbox access for teaching, research, or staff work
Agent Studio and Site Studio for research and web publishing workflows
Media and accessibility tools for transcription, alt text, OCR, and PDFs
Course-specific assistants, tool pilots, workshops, and consultations

campus.label: CUNY College/Campus
campus.placeholder: e.g., Graduate Center, Hunter College, Baruch

intended_use.label: Intended Use
intended_use.placeholder: Describe what you want CAIL to help with, including the course, project, or workflow involved.

tools_of_interest.label: Specific Tools or Support of Interest (Optional)

privacy_note: We use your information to process your request and provide support. Formspree is an external processor; see the processing note below. The CUNY AI Lab follows CUNY's privacy policies. Do not include confidential material, passwords, or API keys in this form.

next_steps.title: Review
next_steps.description: We review your request and reply when we can; timing depends on the request and current capacity.

next_steps.title: Response
next_steps.description: We reply with the likely next step.

next_steps.title: Access or meeting
next_steps.description_html: That may be approved access to the CAIL Sandbox, a consultation, or a pilot conversation.

next_steps.title: Support and recovery
next_steps.description_html: We help match the request to the right tool or workflow. If access stops working or you lose a key, email ailab@gc.cuny.edu; never send a password or key.

questions_text: Have questions before submitting the form?
questions_link_text: Contact the CUNY AI Lab Team →
